name: Nekorekten.com – Official
author: nekorekten

sections.description:
The Nekorekten.com Official Plugin integrates WordPress/WooCommerce stores with the Nekorekten.com customer reputation API. It helps merchants verify customer credibility and prevent fraud by checking customer reports before processing orders.

[BG] Официалният плъгин на Nekorekten.com интегрира WordPress/WooCommerce магазини сAPI за репутация на клиенти на Nekorekten.com. Той помага на търговците да проверяват надеждността на клиентите и да предотвратяват измами чрез проверка на доклади за клиенти преди обработка на поръчки.

Key Features

  • Real-time Customer Verification – Check customer reputation via Nekorekten.com API
  • WooCommerce Orders Integration – Custom column in orders table with visual indicators
  • AJAX-Powered Reports – Instant customer report fetching without page reload
  • Payment Gateway Filtering – Automatically restrict payment methods for flagged customers
  • Order Meta Box – Detailed customer reputation view on order edit pages
  • Manual & Automated Checks – Check on-demand or automatically for new orders
  • Report Submission – Submit new customer reports directly from WooCommerce
  • HPOS Compatible – Supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • Translation Ready – Full i18n support with Bulgarian (bg_BG) included

[BG] Основни функции:

  • Проверка на клиенти в реално време – Проверка на репутацията на клиенти чрез Nekorekten.com API
  • Интеграция с WooCommerce поръчки – Персонализирана колона в таблицата с поръчки с визуални индикатори
  • AJAX доклади – Моментално извличане на доклади за клиенти без презареждане на страницата
  • Филтриране на платежни методи – Автоматично ограничаване на платежни методи за маркирани клиенти
  • Meta Box за поръчки – Детайлен изглед на репутацията на клиента в страниците за редактиране на поръчки
  • Ръчни и автоматични проверки – Проверка при поискване или автоматично за нови поръчки
  • Подаване на доклади – Подаване на нови доклади за клиенти директно от WooCommerce
  • HPOS съвместимост – Поддръжка на WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • Готов за превод – Пълна i18n поддръжка с включен български (bg_BG) превод

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Enter your Nekorekten.com API key in the settings
  3. Configure automatic or manual reputation checks
  4. View customer reputation indicators in your WooCommerce orders table
  5. Prevent fraud by restricting payment methods for flagged customers

[BG] Как работи:

  1. Инсталирайте и активирайте плъгина
  2. Въведете вашия Nekorekten.com API ключ в настройките
  3. Конфигурирайте автоматични или ръчни проверки на репутация
  4. Вижте индикатори за репутация на клиенти в таблицата с WooCommerce поръчки
  5. Предотвратете измами като ограничите платежни методи за маркирани клиенти

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 3.0 or higher (required)
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Valid Nekorekten.com API key (get one at Nekorekten.com)

Privacy & Data

This plugin communicates with the Nekorekten.com API to check customer reputation. The following data may be sent:
* Customer email address
* Customer phone number

By using this plugin, you agree to the Nekorekten.com Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Support

For support, please visit Nekorekten.com or contact us at support@nekorekten.com.

Privacy Policy

This plugin communicates with external services:

Nekorekten.com API
* Service URL: https://api.nekorekten.com
* Purpose: Customer reputation verification
* Data sent: Customer email address, customer phone number
* Privacy Policy: https://nekorekten.com/privacy
* Terms of Service: https://nekorekten.com/terms

The plugin does not store personal data locally beyond what WooCommerce already stores. All reputation checks are performed via the Nekorekten.com API.

Third-Party Services

This plugin relies on the Nekorekten.com API service:

  • Service: Nekorekten.com Customer Reputation API
  • Website: https://nekorekten.com
  • API Endpoint: https://api.nekorekten.com/api/v1/reports
  • Purpose: Verify customer reputation and prevent fraud
  • Data Transmitted: Customer email addresses and phone numbers
  • Privacy Policy: https://nekorekten.com/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://nekorekten.com/terms

By using this plugin, you acknowledge that customer data will be sent to Nekorekten.com for verification purposes.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Nekorekten”
  4. Click “Install Now” on the Nekorekten.com – Official plugin
  5. Activate the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → Nekorekten
  2. Enter your Nekorekten.com API key
  3. Configure your preferences:
    • Enable/disable automatic checks for new orders
    • Choose which payment gateways to restrict for flagged customers
    • Set other options as needed
  4. Save your settings
sections.faq:
Do I need a Nekorekten.com account?

Yes, you need to register at Nekorekten.com and obtain an API key to use this plugin.

Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

No, WooCommerce is required. The plugin will not activate without WooCommerce installed and active.

Is this plugin compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes, the plugin fully supports WooCommerce HPOS.

What data is sent to Nekorekten.com?

The plugin sends customer email addresses and phone numbers to the Nekorekten.com API to check for existing reports.

Can I check customer reputation manually?

Yes, you can click the “?” button in the Nekorekten column on the WooCommerce orders page to manually fetch customer reports.

Will this plugin slow down my checkout process?

No, reputation checks are performed asynchronously and do not affect the checkout flow. Checks can be done manually or automatically after order creation.

What payment gateways can be restricted?

You can configure which payment gateways to hide for customers with negative reports. This is configurable in the plugin settings.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully translation ready and includes Bulgarian (bg_BG) translations.
